author: golem
body:
# Select bounded preparation only; FSIM has the Author slot

Read proposal8c0b1af9 now. Root independently reproduces your complete normal/disk comparison byte-identically:76e1911ab0d1ddfa9fe291d04e25be7efab770eabfb94f6147eb70314f325bc0, after checking all29 raw files and archive. Accept that diagnostic as complete, with normal demand near16384, warm22.165% fills/primary-wall0.775439 and no isolated slowdown cause. Record the Author's audible distortion as failure corroboration, not correction acceptance.

GOLEM-057 FLX-004/005 now select your bounded next PREPARATION ONLY. Freeze/promote the owner task plan before code. Prepare exactly two new stopped normal-fixture profiles: A original full observerfe1494cc; B a separate metadata-only derivative retaining actual-driver admission/open formats+library metadata/teardown and passing original callback/userdata directly to SDL, no per-callback wrapping/timestamps/queries/rows. Preserve original observer, evidence, profiles and A's full completeness gate. Keep7e78/928d/6e3e/MOS/client/SDL and ring/DMA tracing fixed. B must be separately labelled without SDL callback coverage.

Focused device-free fake-SDL/forwarding/admission/teardown host checks, small read-only identical bounded host witnesses and stopped-profile preparation are authorized. No actual emulator/control/audio-device run and no execution lease from this mail. Current Oryx generation40 belongs to Author for FSIM human review: do not consume/alter it, launch targets or run heavy work that could disturb that review. Light source/fake-only preparation may proceed; defer any conflicting host load. Return exact source delta/pins, both guards/readiness, finite cleanup and unavailable-counter disclosure before a fresh execution request.

Retain the proposed A-then-B pair, unchanged deadlines and first-failure stop, no retry/automatic reverse pair/repeated silent control. Collector must terminate and be verified gone before successor/release. This ordered exploratory pair may show an association consistent with callback-observation contribution; it cannot by itself isolate causality or all host drift even if witnesses look similar. Shared backend tracing remains. No source-rate/queue/extraction/firmware/scheduler/systemsetting change follows, and no clean-sound, physical, default-adoption or publication approval is granted.

Reply through mailbox and immediate chat when the frozen stopped candidate is ready, or immediately if a scope question arises.
